Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/942)
Many thanks for your [cheque](/topic/160) which was an agreeable surprise to me. I hope the experiment of cheapness will be successful.

The great day at Hursley is to be the 24th October so if we could have a few of the presentation copies of [John Keble’s parishes](/book/247), it would be a great boon

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
